channel.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK vs the World
channel.desc: The fierce Drag Race UK spin-off continues as our international queens fight to impress Mama Ru and do their countries proud. Phasers set to stun! The queens become 'Space Girls' as they tackle the iconic girl group challenge - but with an inter-gay-lactic twist. Drag Race superfan and chart topper Rag'n'Bone Man drops in to give the queens a masterclass in vocals, while girl group legends Bananarama join RuPaul, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel.
